title: Unveiling the Implicit Toxicity in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLMs on ethical and social dimensions by defining 'implicit toxicity' through a taxonomy that specifically includes 'religion' and 'social norms' under its 'Unfairness and Discrimination' and 'Sensitive Topic' categories. It includes a benchmarking component (Table 4 and Figure 8) and case studies (Table 11, Case #3) evaluating model responses to religious queries.
